criteria.title: Justify publication and reclamation of occupied slots.
criteria.task: Implement separate release/acquire publication and reuse edges with ordinary multiword slot payload. Add a controlled producer/consumer schedule at both edges, a real two-thread run and a model counterexample for weakening either edge. Keep any native racy mutant out of the correctness oracle. Use the earlier analysis as a prediction, not as a substitute for these implementation artifacts. For a reused slot, draw payload-write→release-head→acquire-head→payload-read and payload-read→release-tail→acquire-tail→next-write. Pause each side at the cross-over and reject early overwrite.
criteria.purpose: Only ordering the initial payload before head is necessary.

criteria.title: Address counter wraparound and cache-line placement.
criteria.task: Implement a reduced-width counter oracle that enumerates all reachable empty/full/wrap states for each selected capacity, then compare the actual unsigned-counter queue. Measure the actual atomic lock-free result and object helper references on each available target. Use the earlier analysis as a prediction, not as a substitute for these implementation artifacts. Use reduced-width unsigned monotonic counters and a declared occupancy bound smaller than the modular ambiguity range. Exhaust wrap cases in a model; separately inspect actual cache-line placement and atomic lock freedom.
